data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off improvement for Syndicate 2243 relating to prior year's business was GBP 3.3m. This was mainly attributable to the Construction class which improved by GBP 2.6m following better than expected claims experience in 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a run-off improvement on prior years of GBP 3.3m (a release), principally driven by better-than-expected claims experience in the Construction class which improved by GBP 2.6m. Opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year were GBP 86.725m. The improvement represents approximately a 3.8% release on opening gross reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development sourced from a narrative line in the Technical Provisions note stating a "run-off improvement" of GBP 3.3m. The note does not explicitly state whether this GBP 3.3m is gross or net of reinsurance; it is treated here as a gross prior-year improvement per available narrative (confidence flagged below). The report explicitly attributes GBP 2.6m of the improvement to the Construction class (mapped here to 'Property'). Premium breakdown values taken from the segmental analysis (notes) where amounts are presented in GBP 000. No claims development triangle or explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross table was provided in the extracted pages.
